1000988.name: Sword of the Solitary Heart
1000988.desc:
Ye Shunguang has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Light & Shadow</color>.
[Light & Shadow]: The max stack count of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> increases to 6, and <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> can stack up to 9 times. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, each point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> consumed grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color>'s DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.

1000989.name: Double Lucky Bunny Ears
1000989.desc:
Zhao has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Righteous Verdict</color>.
[Righteous Verdict]: When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.

1000990.name: Wings of Steel
1000990.desc:
Aria has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Energetic Sound Waves</color>.
Energetic Sound Waves：When Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> deals DMG to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup RES</color>. Additionally, when Aria triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base CRIT Rate is 25%, and CRIT DMG is 25%. If initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, each additional point of initial Anomaly Mastery increases this effect's CRIT Rate by 0.5%.

1000991.name: Strawberry Paradise
1000991.desc:
Sunna has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>"Feline Go-With-the-Flow"</color>.
"Feline Go-With-the-Flow"：While Sunna is within any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, all squad members gain 10% ATK and she obtains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpener</color> every 10s. The number of attacks required to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is reduced, and the DMG Multiplier on trigger is increased:
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 200%.
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 300%.

1000992.name: Flawless Plumage
1000992.desc:
Nangong Yu has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Lazy Spotlight]</color>.
[Lazy Spotlight]: When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> hits an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When entering the battlefield, Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeat</color> is restored to the maximum. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.

1000993.name: Guidepost Home
1000993.desc:
Cissia has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Hunger and Hard Truths]</color>.
[Hunger and Hard Truths]: After a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Gang Operation</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Ophidiophobia</color> hits a Stunned enemy, gain an additional 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss</color> deals 35% increased DMG.

1000994.name: Beyond the Shackles
1000994.desc:
Promeia has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Faltering Conviction]</color>.
Faltering Conviction: Promeia's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40. The multiplier of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> triggered by consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> increases by 120%.

1000995.name: Starlight Beacon
1000995.desc:
Starlight - Billy has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Wasteland Automaton]</color>.
Wasteland Automaton：Increases the DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick</color> by 50%. Activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels</color>, or hitting a Stunned enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> grants the <color=#FFFFFF>Turbocharged</color> effect: <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> consumes this effect to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, and increases that instance's CRIT DMG by 50%. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Turbocharged</color> can be held.

1000996.name: Like the Spring Breeze
1000996.desc:
Velina has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Saturation Project]</color>.
[Saturation Project]：When Velina triggers <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>, she can also gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s. After <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> effect, it can accumulate the corresponding attribute's Anomaly Buildup. The buildup accumulated by this attack is excluded from Anomaly DMG calculations. The DMG increase effects of Velina's <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Tea Party Etiquette</color> are further increased by 15%.

1000997.name: En-Nah Laureate
1000997.desc:
Norma has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Visionary Extremism]</color>.
[Visionary Extremism]: The duration of the En-Nah Turret's missile bay deployed by <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment</color> increases to 12s. When an Armor-Piercing Warhead or High-Explosive Warhead from any skill hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1000999.name: Hannibull
1000999.desc:
Remielle has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Fall Into the Noise</color>.
Fall Into the Noise: Remielle's <color=#FFA9DD>Refringe Coefficient</color> increases by 20%. When an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character in the squad deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color>, the attack ignores 15% of the target's DEF. This effect persists for an additional 8s after <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color> ends. While Remielle is in the <Term:1000035></Term> state, the frequency at which she automatically attacks to apply <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to enemies increases.

1001000.name: Legendary Ascent
1001000.desc:
Sigrid has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Long, Long Ago</color>.
Long, Long Ago: Upon activating the 3rd stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>, enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> and gains 1 additional activation of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>. When activations exceed the stored <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>'s activation limit, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>'s final hit deals an additional <color=#FFFFFF>100%</color> of ATK as <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>. Sigrid's <color=#FFFFFF>ATK</color> increases by <color=#FFFFFF>25%</color>.

1002001.name: Bloodfire Rose
1002001.desc:
Claret has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Bloodstained Chronicle</color>.
Bloodstained Chronicle: When Claret's attacks hit enemies and trigger Laceration, Gash Buildup Rate increases by 20%. The DMG Multiplier of Maim triggered by Claret increases to 130% of its original value.

1002002.name: Insomnia Syndrome
1002002.desc:
Roxy has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Clocking Out Myth</color>.
Clocking Out Myth: <color=#ffffff>EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill</color> deals 5% more Daze.
For each <color=#ffffff>Eye of the Storm</color> detonated, gain 1 stack of <color=#ffffff>Windflow</color>, up to 3 stacks.
During <color=#ffffff>EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill</color>, if Roxy switches out after entering the <color=#ffffff>Whirlwind</color> state, she consumes all <color=#ffffff>Windflow</color>. Each stack consumed sustains the <color=#ffffff>Whirlwind</color> state for 0.2s, during which no Energy is consumed, up to a maximum of 0.6s.
When <color=#ffffff>EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill</color> hits an enemy, that enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% until the target recovers from Stun.

1002003.name: Lingering Pain and a Procession of Stimuli
1002003.desc:
Phoenix has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Lingering Pain and Thrilling Procession]</color>.
Lingering Pain and Thrilling Procession: Upon entering the battlefield, Phoenix gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Ascension</color>. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
The CRIT DMG of Anomaly DMG dealt to enemies in the <color=#FFFFFF>Sear</color> state is increased by an additional 25%.
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Combustion Attack</color> deals DMG, <color=#FFFFFF>Pyre</color> generation efficiency increases by 15%.

1002004.name: Double Espresso
1002004.desc:
Severian has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Double Espresso]</color>.
Double Espresso：When Severian uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the accumulated <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> increases to 50.
When Severian switches in through <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Clear Out</color>, the skill is replaced with a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. The entry type is not changed, and it is treated as a non-heavy attack. This effect can trigger once every 60s.
Each time Severian uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>, he gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Windborne</color>.
When Severian's attacks hit a target, they ignore 15% of the target's Wind RES.

1002301.name: [Affinity] Attack Tactical Exchange
1002301.desc: Increases Attack specialty Agent CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.

1002302.name: [Affinity] Stun Tactical Exchange
1002302.desc: Stun specialty Agents inflict <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> more Daze.

1002303.name: [Affinity] Anomaly Tactical Exchange
1002303.desc: Increases Anomaly specialty Agent Anomaly Mastery by <color=#2BAD00>20</color>.

1002304.name: [Affinity] Support Tactical Exchange
1002304.desc: Increases Support specialty Agent Energy Regen by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.

1002305.name: [Affinity] Defense Tactical Exchange
1002305.desc: Defense specialty Agents take <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> less DMG.

1002306.name: [Affinity] Rupture Tactical Exchange
1002306.desc: Increases Rupture specialty Agent Sheer DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.

1002307.name: [Affinity] Armorer Tactical Exchange
1002307.desc: Agents with the Armorer specialty deal <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> bonus Sharp DMG.

1310101.name: [Ultimate] Echoing Zither
1310101.desc: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the Agent has a 50% chance to <color=#2BAD00>recover 15% of Decibels consumed</color>.

1310102.name: [Ultimate] Charging Drum
1310102.desc: When a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>gains 300 additional Decibels</color>. This effect can trigger once every 30s.

1310103.name: [Ultimate] Repeating Synth
1310103.desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> hits an enemy, <color=#2BAD00>it deals DMG equal to 2,500% of the Agent's ATK</color> to the target. This effect can trigger once every 30s.

1310104.name: [Ultimate] Heavy Drum Sticks
1310104.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG is <color=#2BAD00>increased by 20%</color>. When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate is increased by 10%</color> for 15s.

1310105.name: [Ultimate] Endless Flute
1310105.desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> hits an enemy, <color=#2BAD00>it deals DMG over time equal to 20% of the Agent's ATK</color> per second to the target for 10s.

1310106.name: [Ultimate] Remedial Harp
1310106.desc: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, if the Agent has a shield, <color=#2BAD00>they recover 5% HP</color>. If not, <color=#2BAD00>they gain a shield equal to 15% of their Max HP</color> for 7s.

1310201.name: [Dexterity] Advanced Chassis
1310201.desc: The Agent <color=#2BAD00>gains an extra dodge</color>. Their <color=#2BAD00>ATK increases by 300</color> for 5s when a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> is triggered.

1310202.name: [Dexterity] Safety Airbag
1310202.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> <color=#2BAD00>deals 20% more DMG and inflicts 20% more Daze</color>. When an Agent triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, they <color=#2BAD00>gain a shield equal to 10% Max HP</color>.

1310203.name: [Dexterity] Sensitive Gear
1310203.desc: When triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 10%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Impact is increased by 5%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

1310204.name: [Dexterity] Smart Buffer
1310204.desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>gains a shield equal to 5% of their Max HP</color> for 10s. While the shield is active, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>deals 10% more DMG</color>.

1310205.name: [Dexterity] Protective Safety Belt
1310205.desc: The Agent takes <color=#2BAD00>10% less DMG</color>. When shielded, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Energy Regen is increased by 10%</color>.

1310206.name: [Dexterity] Efficient Bumper
1310206.desc: When launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color>, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate is increased by 10%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG is increased by 15%</color> for 15s.

1310301.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Universal Catalyst
1310301.desc: When Stunning or inflicting Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate is increased by 8%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency is increased by 15</color> for 20s, stacking up to 2 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

1310302.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Shattered Test Tube
1310302.desc: When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy, the target's <color=#2BAD00>Stun DMG Multiplier is increased by 25%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt to the target due to Attribute Anomaly is increased by 25%</color> for 10s.

1310303.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Growth Culture Medium
1310303.desc: When an enemy is hit, <color=#2BAD00>Daze is increased by 15%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup is increased by 15%</color>.

1310304.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Research Microscope
1310304.desc: All squad members' <color=#2BAD00>Impact is increased by 10%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency is increased by 10</color>.

1310305.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Chaos Measuring Beaker
1310305.desc: When Stunning or inflicting Disorder on an enemy, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>recovers 2.5% HP</color>, <color=#2BAD00>10 Energy</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>an additional 100 Decibels</color>. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

1310306.name: [Anomaly - Stun] Compound Stimulant
1310306.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> <color=#2BAD00>deals 15% increased DMG</color> and Attribute Anomaly <color=#2BAD00>deals 15% increased DMG</color>.

1310401.name: [Adversity] Powerful Dialysis Machine
1310401.desc: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>recovers 10 Energy</color> while <color=#CF4029>consuming 20% of current HP</color>. For every 100 HP consumed, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt is increased by 1%</color> for 10s.

1310403.name: [Adversity] Emergency Partition
1310403.desc: When losing HP, <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt by the Agent is increased by 20%</color>, <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate is increased by 10%</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level is increased</color>, lasting for 10s and triggering once every 20s.

1310404.name: [Adversity] Dual Injection Needle
1310404.desc: DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> is <color=#2BAD00>increased by 15%</color>. When the skill hits an enemy, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>recovers 5% HP</color>. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

1310405.name: [Adversity] Targeted Antibodies
1310405.desc: When attacking enemies with a higher HP percentage than the Agent, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt is increased by 10%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup is increased by 10%</color>.

1310406.name: [Adversity] Pain-Killer Hormones
1310406.desc: When losing HP, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>ATK is increased by 10%</color> for 10s. When recovering HP, the Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 10%</color> for 10s.

1310901.name: [General] Lucky Stars
1310901.desc: Launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases the Agent's DMG by 5%</color> for 30s, stacking up to 5 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

1310903.name: [General] Energy Restorer MKII
1310903.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG increases by 15%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Daze inflicted increases by 10%</color>.

1310904.name: [General] Water Gun
1310904.desc: Landing a critical hit <color=#2BAD00>increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by 3%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

1310905.name: [General] Bubble Gun
1310905.desc: Landing a critical hit <color=#2BAD00>increases Daze inflicted by the Agent by 15%</color> for 3s.

1310906.name: [General] Like & Subscribe Gun
1310906.desc: Each non-critical hit <color=#2BAD00>increases the Agent's CRIT Rate by 6%</color>. This effect is reset after the Agent triggers a critical hit.

1310907.name: [General] Falling Starsea Armor
1310907.desc: Hitting an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> <color=#2BAD00>generates a Shield equal to 10% of the Agent's Max HP</color>. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

1310908.name: [General] Ultra Sacred Sword of Radiance
1310908.desc: Shielded Agents <color=#2BAD00>deal 30% more DMG</color> to enemies within 6m.

1310909.name: [General] BUG Shield
1310909.desc: When attacked, if the Agent's HP is below 25%, <color=#2BAD00>a shield that is equal to 15% of Max HP</color> is generated for 10s. (This effect can only be triggered once by each Agent per combat encounter.)

1310911.name: [General] Three Glass Marbles
1310911.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Increases the duration that enemies are stunned for by 15%</color>.

1310912.name: [General] Tri-End Toy Stethoscope
1310912.desc: <color=#2BAD00>Increases Daze inflicted by <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> by 15%</color>.

1310913.name: [General] Bomb Difuser
1310913.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> triggered by <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color> <color=#2BAD00>lasts 5s longer</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> <color=#2BAD00>inflicts 30% more Daze</color>.

1310914.name: [General] Demolition Hammer
1310914.desc: Triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by 25%</color> for 10s.

1310915.name: [General] Hammer Drill
1310915.desc: Triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 20%</color> for 10s.

1310916.name: [General] Untitled Book
1310916.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG increases by 30%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Daze inflicted increases by 15%</color>.

1310917.name: [General] Secret File
1310917.desc: When attacked, quickly press Dodge to <color=#2BAD00>immediately break free</color> and <color=#2BAD00>recover 50% of the DMG taken as HP</color>. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>4</color>s.

1310918.name: [General] General File
1310918.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is <color=#2BAD00>easier</color> to trigger, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG is increased by 15%</color>.

1310919.name: [General] Sword Catalog
1310919.desc: Agents <color=#2BAD00>deal 25% more DMG</color> but also <color=#CF4029>take 15% more DMG</color>.

1310920.name: [General] Insect Catalog
1310920.desc: Attacks against enemies with less than 50% HP <color=#2BAD00>deal 15% more DMG</color>.

1310921.name: [General] Plant Catalog
1310921.desc: Off-field Agents with 25% or lower HP <color=#2BAD00>slowly recover HP</color>.

1310932.name: Suction Welding Torch
1310932.desc: A magical item that maximizes the level of corresponding General Gear in your collectibles.

1340074.name: Copper Paperweight
1340074.desc: Agent's reduction efficiency against <color=#FFAF2C>Miasmic Shield</color> increases by 15%.

1340075.name: Embroidered Sachet
1340075.desc: When an Agent is attacked by a monster's Miasma Corruption attack, the accumulated <color=#FFAF2C>Miasma Contamination</color> value reduces by 20%.

1340076.name: Gilded Ink Block
1340076.desc: When the Agent is inside the <color=#FFAF2C>Miasmic Field</color>, DMG dealt increases by 30%.

1311001.name: [Mobile] Energy-Saving Vehicle
1311001.desc: When other characters use <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color>, the active character <color=#2BAD00>recovers 5 Energy and 200 Decibels</color>. This effect can trigger once every 10s per character.

1311002.name: [Mobile] Mighty Fists
1311002.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> will execute normal enemies and Elite enemies with HP below 15%. When triggered, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00>ATK increases by 10%</color> for 30s.

1311003.name: [Mobile] Carousel
1311003.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershocks</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG increases by 20%, Daze by 15%, and Anomaly Buildup by 30%</color>.

1311004.name: [Mobile] Inflatable Swimming Ring
1311004.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>restores 5% HP</color> for the active character. Each character can trigger this effect once every 15s.

1311005.name: [Mobile] Kids' Lunchbox
1311005.desc: The active character's <color=#2BAD00>Energy Generation Rate increases by 10% and Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%</color>.

1311006.name: [Mobile] Hurricane Swing
1311006.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> <color=#2BAD00>reduces DEF by 10%</color> for 10s upon hitting an enemy.

1319901.name: Geppetto - Stable Restraint
1319901.desc: For every 100 Gear Coins owned, gain a buff that increases DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>1%</color> and Energy Generation Rate by <color=#2BAD00>0.5%</color> when dealing DMG to Geppetto.

1319902.name: Geppetto - Blood for Blood
1319902.desc: When Geppetto becomes Impaired, all squad members recover <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> HP.

1319903.name: Geppetto - Melee Thrust
1319903.desc: Increase DMG dealt to Geppetto by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> and reduce DMG received from Geppetto by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.

1319904.name: Geppetto - Moment of Judgment
1319904.desc: When Geppetto becomes Impaired, its DEF drops by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>, stacking up to 2 times.

1319905.name: Geppetto - Execution Order
1319905.desc: When Suspended is removed, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>300</color> Decibels, and the next <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG of each Agent is increased by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.

1001058.name: [Hollow] Koleda's Demolition Hammer
1001058.desc: <color=#FFAF2C>Spikes no longer deal damage</color>, but instead grant <color=#2BAD00>+3</color> HP.

1001061.name: [Hollow] VIP Card
1001061.desc: Receive <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> of spent Coins back when purchasing items.

1001062.name: [Hollow] Health Medicine
1001062.desc: When picking up Coins, there is a 50% chance to generate a <color=#2BAD00>Health Recovery Tile</color>.

1001063.name: [Hollow] Combo Sword
1001063.desc: When picking up coins, there's a 50% chance to generate an <color=#FFAF2C>explosive bomb</color>.

1001064.desc: When picking up Coins, there is a 50% chance to generate an <color=#2BAD00>EXP Tile</color>.

1001065.name: [Hollow] Combat Gloves Module
1001065.desc: When picking up Coins, there is a 25% chance to spawn a <color=#CF4029>monster</color>.

1001066.name: [Hollow] Farewell Paper Cranes
1001066.desc: Place 1 additional <color=#FFAF2C>explosive bomb</color> above and below when placing bombs.

1001067.name: [Hollow] Bangboo Stand-In
1001067.desc: 50% chance to generate a <color=#2BAD00>Coin Tile</color> when defeating monsters.

1001068.name: [Hollow] Endgame Wish Star
1001068.desc: <color=#CF4029>Health Recovery Tiles no longer restore HP</color>, instead giving all squad members <color=#2BAD00>+1</color> ATK

1001069.name: [Hollow] Combo Sword
1001069.desc: Gain a temporary <color=#2BAD00>+1</color> ATK when killing monsters. Resets at the end of each floor.

1001070.name: [Hollow] Enhanced Health Medicine
1001070.desc: Generate 1 <color=#FFAF2C>explosive bomb</color> every 5 moves and lose <color=#CF4029>3</color> HP.

1001072.name: [Hollow] Hollow Robot
1001072.desc: Significantly increase the chance to generate good items when smashing <color=#2BAD00>Ether crystals</color>

1001073.name: [Hollow] Jackbox Bomb
1001073.desc: At the start of each floor, generate <color=#CF4029>15 spikes</color> and <color=#2BAD00>2 Resonium Tiles</color> throughout the floor.

1001074.name: [Hollow] Security Scanner
1001074.desc: When stepping on spikes, <color=#2BAD00>no HP is lost</color>, but 1 <color=#FFAF2C>explosive bomb</color> is generated.
